name: Squad Six
northStar: The trail party: every day trained is a painted blaze on your tree.

motion.rule: short ease-out; one fade-in per onboarding screen; honor Reduce Motion

rules: Sage (dark) / emerald (light) is the only action colour.
Circles only for people; everything else has small radii (4-8).
No kicker labels above headings, no gradients, no pill buttons.
No warning or danger colours on people.
